data.name: Eggscape
data.detailed_description:
CRACK INTO CHAOS

Eggscape is a chaotic multiplayer party brawler where egg-shaped warriors battle and cause absolute mayhem across vibrant arenas. Grab a weapon, dress up your egg, and jump into the fray with up to 6 players.

Made by an animation studio, which is why every egg panics, flails and dies with the timing of a cartoon. Under the slapstick: deterministic netcode built to keep six players of physics chaos in sync.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Eggscape is pure friend-group energy: easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and absolutely unfair in the funniest ways. Betray your best friend with a bazooka. Steal the piggy at the last second.

Want to bring the whole squad? Grab the 2-Pack or the 4-Pack and get everyone in at a discount. Extra copies go to your Steam inventory so you can gift them to friends.

3 GAME MODES

  • Battle — Free-for-all arena combat. Last egg standing takes the crown.

  • Team Battle — Squad-based warfare. Coordinate, dominate, celebrate.

  • Greedy Piggy — Grab the piggy, hoard points, and dodge everyone trying to steal it.

AN ARSENAL FIT FOR AN EGG

15 weapons across 4 categories — because even eggs need firepower.

  • Melee — Fists, Bat, Spear, Fire Spear

  • Ranged — Shotgun, Laser, Laser Mini, Laser Triple

  • Explosive — Bazooka, Bazooka Mini, Bazooka Triple, Grenade

  • Special — Flamethrower, Spinning Ball, and more on the way

DRESS YOUR EGG

119+ cosmetics across 5 rarity tiers. Hats, glasses, shirts, full-body outfits — from Pirate Looks to Sushi Rolls, Space Helmets to Tentacle Bodies. Mix and match across 4 body slots to create the egg of your nightmares. Or dreams. We don't judge.

COMPETE AND PROGRESS

  • Leaderboards — Climb the ranks, prove you're the top egg

  • Achievements — Track your milestones

  • XP & Leveling — Every match counts toward your progression

MULTIPLAYER FIRST

  • Up to 6 players per match

  • Online matchmaking and private rooms

  • Party system and friends list

  • Voice chat

  • Powered by Photon Quantum deterministic netcode for tick-perfect sync

NO PAY-TO-WIN. EVER.

Every weapon and game mode is included with the game. Cosmetics can be earned through gameplay. Look good because you played hard, not because you paid more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space

  • DirectX: Version 12
